missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments-C024 (partial): A promised case is missing, and the claim that the entry supplies Exercise 3.3.24 is only partly supported. The entry (parts/p15/characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments.tex 451-463) says it supplies "Exercise 3.3.24". In the held source (Durrett v5, PDF p.151, book p.143) that exercise asks for two things: show nu_k^{1/k} -> lambda, "so the assumption of Theorem 3.3.26 holds if lambda < infinity". The body and the annex proof (annex 1038-1077) prove only nu_k^{1/k} -> Lambda (annex 1040-1052, including nu_k^{1/k} <= Lambda) and, separately, compact Hamburger determinacy by polynomial approximation (annex 1054-1075). No line states or derives that the growth hypothesis of thm:p15-criteria-moment-method / thm:p15-criteria-analytic-determinacy (limsup m_{2k}^{1/(2k)}/(2k) < infinity) holds when Lambda < infinity. The exercise's concluding clause is therefore not supplied.

ED26-P15-CH-characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments-C032 (partial): The boundary's claim is not fully supported. The proofboundary (body 588-603) says that this chapter, together with the inversion chapter, supplies "Exercises 3.3.1--3.3.25". Every other pointer resolves on route: Exercises 3.3.1-3.3.4, 3.3.6 and 3.3.16 are in the inversion chapter; 3.3.5 and 3.3.7-3.3.25 are here; the numbered theorems and examples, the three counterexamples, the Carleman proof and the CLT/NDA targets were all checked. But the concluding clause of Exercise 3.3.24 is supplied nowhere (see criteria C024), so the full-supply claim overstates. This clears once that clause is supplied.

ED26-P15-CH-weak-convergence-of-laws-C024 (partial): The boundary's claim is not fully supported. In the proofboundary (parts/p15/weak-convergence-of-laws.tex 471-498), the Section 3.2 scope checked out on route: Examples 3.2.1-3.2.6, Lemma 3.2.7, Theorems 3.2.8-3.2.15, Scheffe, and all seventeen exercises. The Section 3.1, 3.4 and NDA pointers also resolve. However, lines 480-482 say "all section exercises" of Section 3.3 are supplied in sec:p15-characteristic-function-criteria-and-moments. (1) The concluding clause of Exercise 3.3.24 is supplied nowhere (see criteria C024). (2) Exercises 3.3.1-3.3.4, 3.3.6 and 3.3.16 are supplied only in sec:p15-characteristic-functions-and-inversion (that chapter's lines 99-119, 256-296 and 382-416), so the stated location points to the wrong chapter for them.

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-feller-weak-law-presentation-C005 (partial): The success condition requires 'construction or argument ... and the full treatment promised by its declared status' (proved=annex:p15.feller-largest-term-inequality). This is not met for the non-strict case. The promised comparison P(|S|>=t) >= 1/2 P(max_i|Y_i|>=t) carries the stated q_>= bound and the 'exact source CDF form' V.(5.10), which is the preserved source variant with a non-strict left side. The annex discharges it only with 'The same reasoning with M>=t gives the non-strict comparison' (handbook/annex/p15/feller-weak-law-presentation.tex 147-149). That is a 'similarly' step, not written steps. The strict case, the four-pair invariance and the exponential/CDF reductions are fully written.

ED26-P15-CH-weak-laws-and-triangular-arrays-C011 (partial): The success condition requires 'construction or argument ... and the full treatment promised by its declared status' (proved=annex:p15.levy-symmetric-maximal). This is not met for the promised non-strict case. The body says the first inequality 'also holds with both strict inequalities replaced by non-strict ones' (handbook/parts/p15/weak-laws-and-triangular-arrays.tex 246-247). The annex gives only a sketch: 'use the first crossing of |T_k|>=t, split at T_k>=t and T_k<=-t, and use the same argument with terminal threshold >=t' (handbook/annex/p15/weak-laws-and-triangular-arrays.tex 379-381). That is a 'same argument' step, not written steps. Both strict inequalities are fully proved.
